scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem concerns exactly three ones on a circular binary word, complete multiplicity-preserving oriented cyclic reads, and reconstruction modulo rotation only. Full proof of the infinite result is included; exhaustive checks are independent bounded corroboration, not an infinite certificate. Originality assessment is relative to inspected literature and indexed findings, not a completeness guarantee.
title: Sharp \(\lfloor 2n/3\rfloor\) reconstruction threshold and last-step fibers for three-marker circular words
